Inside The Beauty Business Blueprint

Eight weeks, one clear plan

Each week has its own focus, so you put what you learn into your business as you go. Tap a week to see everything in it.

01Week 1Vision + Goals

Most beauty pros work hard in a business they’ve never really looked at. This week we lay it all out: your numbers, your schedule, what’s working and what’s quietly draining you. You leave with a clear picture of your business and a 60-day plan that tells you what to focus on first.

02Week 2Service Efficiency + Time Management

If every appointment runs long and you’re wiped out by the end of the day, your workflow is the problem. We break down your service from setup to checkout and tighten your tools, your flow and your appointment timing. You walk away with a routine that’s faster, smoother and easier on your body.

03Week 3Brand Positioning

When you look like everyone else, price is the only thing clients can compare. We define who you’re really for, the signature service you want to be known for, and an offer lineup that makes booking you an easy yes. You leave knowing exactly why your ideal client should choose you.

04Week 4Marketing

Posting every day and still hearing crickets? We audit your page, then build a Reels and Stories plan that builds trust and sends people straight to your booking link. No more posting and hoping. You’ll have a simple system that turns followers into appointments.

05Week 5Business Systems

Chasing rebookings in the DMs, letting no-shows slide, paying yourself whatever’s left: that’s how burnout starts. We set up the systems behind a premium business: scheduling, rebooking, automations that handle the follow-up for you, policies that protect your time, and a real plan to pay yourself. You leave with a business that keeps clients coming back without you chasing them.

06Week 6Revenue Expansion

You don’t need a new certification or a brand-new audience to grow your income. The skills you’ve built and the clients who already trust you are the start of your next offer. This week we figure out what that offer is, who it’s for and how to bring it to the people already in your chair. You walk away with a clear next offer and a plan to launch it.

07Week 7Mindset + CEO Identity

You can have every strategy in place and still feel stuck if you don’t see yourself as the one running the business. This week we take on what’s really holding you back: imposter syndrome, comparing yourself to others in your industry, people-pleasing, the fear of losing clients, and showing up only when you feel motivated. Then we build the CEO side of you. That means making decisions with confidence, setting boundaries that protect your time and energy, standing behind your prices and staying consistent on the slow weeks too. You’ll be leading your business instead of letting it lead you.

08Week 890-Day Growth Plan

We look back at how far you’ve come, celebrate the wins and lay out your next quarter step by step. You won’t finish wondering “now what?” You’ll have a 90-day growth plan built around your goals and your real calendar.

Questions

Good to know

When does it start?

Monday, November 9. Calls are Mondays at 7:30 PM Eastern and run 90 minutes each. You will get the call details by email after you join.

What if I can’t make a live call?

Every call is recorded, and you will receive the recording.

What’s the difference between Standard and VIP?

Both include all eight weeks, the live group calls and recordings, the homework, and all three bonuses. VIP adds three 1:1 strategy calls with me, personalized to your business, and a 90-day growth plan built 1:1 with me. Standard members build their 90-day growth plan in our Week 8 group call.

Who is this for?

Lash artists, brow artists, hairstylists, makeup artists, and other beauty professionals who want to grow their business with clearer positioning, better systems, and more intentional marketing.

Will this guarantee more clients or income?

No one can promise that. You will get a clear plan, honest feedback, and accountability. Your results depend on your business and how much you put into the homework.

How many seats are there?

This founding round has 15 seats, and only 5 of them are VIP. Founding prices end Friday, November 6 at 11:59 PM Eastern.

What is the Two-Week Clarity Guarantee?

Join the Week 1 and Week 2 calls, live or by recording, complete the homework for both weeks, and apply what we cover. If you still don’t have more clarity about your business, email rieartistrystudio@gmail.com by 11:59 PM Eastern on Monday, November 23, with proof of your completed Week 1 and Week 2 homework, and you will get a full refund. This applies to Standard and VIP. Full details are in our Terms.
